ordinary_actionable_recourse_baseline.description: minimum cost subject to the same factual chance-validity constraint and abstention rule as the primary method, without the prediction-Wasserstein constraint

distribution_constrained_objective: minimize cost subject to factual success probability and recipient-conditional prediction-Wasserstein constraints; return the factual plan and mark abstention if infeasible
interval_scope: individual bootstrap; fitted models held fixed
reference: prediction draws under W|X=advantaged,Z_recipient with the recipient's Z held fixed
